title: Grade 1 9.01
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 1: Identify a whole | Understand a whole | Understand parts | Identify wholes | Identify parts | Understand wholes | Distinguish whole and part | Compare whole and part | Compare sizes | Connect whole and part

questions.question: A whole shape has how many pieces?
questions.solution: Count each object once, then match that total to the choices. The total count is 1.
